$comment: Findings of CompatibilityOracleTest that are tracked by an open issue. Each entry matches finding ids ('*' matches anything); the first matching entry wins, so more specific entries come first. The test fails on a finding matched by no entry, and on an entry that matches no finding, so the fix for an issue removes its entries. Ids read '<base> @<draft> <location> <edit> apply|revert' for mutations and 'catalogue: <case id> backward|forward' for catalogue cases.

knownFailures.pattern: catalogue: Basic: typed schema replaced with 'true' *
